user.title: Add a filament box
user.description: Every hub is one filament box (or shelf); its spools are added afterwards from the hub's entry (the "+ Add" button). Leave the humidity limit and delay empty to use the values of the most sensitive material stored in the box; leave the maximum number of spools empty for no limit.

reconfigure.title: Edit filament box
reconfigure.description: Update the box's name, humidity, notification and spool-limit settings. Leave the limit and delay empty to use the values of the most sensitive material stored in the box.

error.name_required: Please enter a name for the filament box.

user.title: Add a filament spool
user.description: What kind of spool is it?

details.title: Spool details
details.description: Total weight is suggested from the material/manufacturer you picked where known, otherwise a generic default - always editable.

name.title: Name the spool
name.description: Suggested from the material, color and manufacturer you picked. Feel free to change it.

reconfigure.title: Edit spool
reconfigure.description: Update the spool's details. Use the remaining-weight entity or the consume_filament / refill_spool services to change how much filament is left.

error.name_required: Please enter a name for the spool.
error.remaining_exceeds_total: The remaining weight cannot be greater than the total weight.

abort.box_full: This filament box is already full.

consume_filament.name: Consume filament
consume_filament.description: Reduces a spool's remaining weight by the given amount.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Amount of filament used, in grams.

refill_spool.name: Refill spool
refill_spool.description: Resets a spool's remaining weight, e.g. after mounting a fresh one.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: New remaining weight in grams. If left empty, the spool is reset to its total weight.
